WITH ss_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1' ELSE NULL END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_ext_tax_1_to_20,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net_paid_1_to_20
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY bucket
),
ss_aggregates_21_to_40 AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2' ELSE NULL END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_ext_tax_21_to_40,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net_paid_21_to_40
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY bucket
),
ss_aggregates_41_to_60 AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3' ELSE NULL END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_ext_tax_41_to_60,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net_paid_41_to_60
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY bucket
),
ss_aggregates_61_to_80 AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4' ELSE NULL END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_ext_tax_61_to_80,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net_paid_61_to_80
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY bucket
),
ss_aggregates_81_to_100 AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5' ELSE NULL END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_ext_tax_81_to_100,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net_paid_81_to_100
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(avg_ext_tax_1_to_20, avg_net_paid_1_to_20) * 1071 AS bucket1,
    COALESCE(avg_ext_tax_21_to_40, avg_net_paid_21_to_40) * 39161 AS bucket2,
    COALESCE(avg_ext_tax_41_to_60, avg_net_paid_41_to_60) * 29434 AS bucket3,
    COALESCE(avg_ext_tax_61_to_80, avg_net_paid_61_to_80) * 6568 AS bucket4,
    COALESCE(avg_ext_tax_81_to_100, avg_net_paid_81_to_100) * 21216 AS bucket5
FROM 
    ss_aggregates
